LanguageData.RR_Field_CannotDeploy: Select an upright expedition worker at a surveyed site with a clear place to work.
LanguageData.RR_Field_AidMissing: This worker is not carrying the requested route equipment. Collect or transfer the physical item first.
LanguageData.RR_Field_AidAlreadyPlaced: This room already has that type of route equipment. Recover or move it before deploying another.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorMismatch: {0}: a doorway repeats the last room's label, but the route counter disagrees. Stop and compare the physical route tags. The last validated junction is room {1}; a tag and return beacon there identify the safe route. Continuing deeper risks a loop.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorCountered: Tag and beacon agree at room {0}. The crew identified the false connection and preserved the return path.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorLoop: The doorway returned the crew to room {0}. Three reported in-game minutes were lost; no injury occurred and the gate exit is unchanged.
LanguageData.RR_Event_CorridorRouteBlocked: The last junction is obstructed. The route distortion stopped without moving the crew. Clear the route or request recall.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RouteAidPlaced: Placed {0} in room {1}. Its physical position now supports the saved route.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerSighting: Quiet Pursuer reported in room {0}, {1} rooms away. Keep moving along your route, retreat behind a closed door, or prepare to repel it. The threshold remains safe.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerAdvance: The figure is now in room {0}, about {1} connected rooms from the nearest crew member.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerContactWarning: The figure is in the same room as {0}. Move away or repel it now. Contact may occur after one further reported in-game minute.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerInjury: {0} was struck once and injured. The figure withdrew. Assess the wound and use ordinary medical treatment.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerRepelled: The attack forced the figure back to room {0}. The crew has another warning interval to withdraw.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerWithdrawn: The figure withdrew. This opening will not spawn another encounter.

LanguageData.RR_UI_FieldObjectives: Survey the six required room families with the recorder, document the route mismatch, collect the physical recording, and return it with the evidence case. A clear entity observation and all three original crew returning qualify for the bonus. Place tags and the return beacon at a known junction to counter the loop.
LanguageData.RR_Event_PursuerPlacementFailed: The encounter could not be placed safely. No entity sighting was recorded. The crew and saved route remain available; consult the game log before a later visit.
